Subject: Quick office-hours check-in — Arcadia trial preflight

Hi Olivia / Marc —

We had you on the calendar for a 30-min office-hours slot today to walk through the trial integration (API keys, SDK install, quick token test). Zoom link was in the calendar invite: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9876543210.

Agenda (15 minutes):
- Confirm API key provisioning and environment variables
- Validate SDK installation (Node/Python) and run a hello-world request
- Troubleshoot any CORS / proxy issues your devs are seeing

I attached a short preflight checklist you can skim before we meet. If this time no longer works, reply with a couple of windows and we can rebook.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you unblocked.

—

Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick office-hours check-in — Arcadia trial preflight

Hi Olivia —

We waited in the Zoom for ~15 minutes but didn’t hear from your side. No worries — things happen. I wanted to send a quick checklist so your engineers can try a couple of quick preflight steps before we reschedule; doing these ahead of time will make the 30-min slot more effective: 

Preflight (can be run in ~5 minutes):
- Confirm API key: echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY (or check your env config)
- Run a quick curl test: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
- Check SDK version: npm ls @redwoodai/sdk OR pip show redwood-sdk
- Inspect browser console for CORS errors when using client-side calls (prefer dev proxy to avoid exposing keys)

If you prefer, I can send a short troubleshooting session with one of our integration engineers. I’ve got availability tomorrow (Wed) 10:00–11:30 PT and Thu 14:00–16:00 PT. Please send back a preferred 30-min slot and I’ll send an updated invite.

Thanks —
Vanessa
[Attachment: trial_preflight_checklist.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick office-hours check-in — Arcadia trial preflight

Vanessa —

If you want me to join the next session, I can cover a few quick troubleshooting steps we see commonly:
- Confirm the key scope (Read vs Read+Write) in the org console — sometimes trial keys are created with limited scopes.
- If the curl above returns a 401, try the key in a direct postman request to rule out proxy/network issues.
- For Node SDKs, ensure INSTALL step used --save and node_modules resolved to the same Node version the app runs on.

One tip: if they use an SSO-enabled org, API keys sometimes get blocked until an admin enables service tokens — ask them to check Settings -> API Access.

I can drop into the calendar at any of the slots Vanessa suggested. Happy to handle the quick debug so we can keep the momentum.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@arcadiaapps.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marc Liu <marc@arcadiaapps.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick office-hours check-in — Arcadia trial preflight

Hi Vanessa / Marissa —

Apologies for missing our scheduled time — we had an internal standup overrun and by the time we were free the meeting was over. Thank you for the follow-ups and the checklist — super helpful.

Update: we ran the curl test and were getting a 401; turns out I had the wrong env var configured (we were using REDWOOD_KEY instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY). Once I updated that, the request authenticated but we saw a CORS error in the browser.

Would you be able to book a 30-min troubleshooting slot with Marissa? Our team is available Fri, Oct 23 between 08:00–11:00 PT or Mon, Oct 26 after 13:00 PT. Either works for a short screen-share.

I attached a quick screenshot of the console error in case that helps.

Thanks again — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Platform Engineer, Arcadia Apps
olivia@arcadiaapps.com
